versions.changelog:
- Generalized JSON input/output code examples to use generic names and fields for improved documentation clarity.
- Unified package name and naming conventions in generated Java code examples; class names now use PascalCase with "Test" suffix and remove non-ASCII characters automatically.
- Simplified Python API usage; now a single generator entry point with configurable package name.
- Added explicit documentation of code quality standards, naming conventions, assertion usage, and test result locations.
- Updated prompt templates and version/date info for improved guidance and traceability.

Initial release of JUnit 5 Test Generator.

- Generates JUnit 5 test classes from JSON test case files, following Spring Boot best practices.
- Supports parsing of test case JSONs (generated by "Test Case Generator"), extracting data, setup/teardown scripts, and metadata.
- Automatically produces test classes and test methods for multiple scenarios, including API and service layer tests.
- Batch processing of multiple test case files is supported.
- Includes Python scripts for one-click generation and a flexible Python API for integration.
- Offers SQL setup/teardown execution for database-related test preparation and cleanup.
